z-m-21-01.title: Isiphelo "enye kuphela": ingaba yeyodwa ngokwenene?
z-m-21-01.topic: Ukubhala intetho yezinga lesi-4 njengemveliso yeentetho ezimbini zekhwadrathi: ukujonga onke amatyala anokwenzeka
z-m-21-01.goal: Jonga isiphelo "enye kuphela" esafikelelwa emva kokujonga amanye amatyala anokwenzeka, yenza iimveliso ezahlukeneyo zeentetho zekhwadrathi kwintetho enye yezinga lesi-4 ukuze uqinisekise, uze uchaze isizathu sokuba inani leendlela lilungiswe nokuba iimeko ziyandiswa.
z-m-21-01.material: U-Jiho ufumene indlela yokubhala i-x⁴−5x²+4 ngefom (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d). Apha ikoyifishenti ye-x² yi-1 kuzo zombini iintetho zekhwadrathi, a, b, c, d ziiinteger, kwaye ukutshintshisa ulandelelwano lweentetho ezimbini zekhwadrathi (umzekelo, ukutshintshisa a, b ne-c, d) kubalwa njengokwahlula okufanayo. Emva kokugqiba isisombululo, u-Jiho uthe, "Kukho ukwahlula okunjalo okunye kuphela." Ngezantsi sisisombululo sika-Jiho. (Indlela yokufunda: x⁴ yi "x kumandla esine", x² yi "x isikwere", kwaye ac yi "a amaxesha c".)
z-m-21-01.thinking.1: Ukwenza imizekelo eyahlukileyo yakho ephula isiphelo
z-m-21-01.thinking.2: Ukugweba ukuba isiphelo sitshintsha njani xa imeko itshintshwa (ii-integer ziye kumanani okwenyani)
z-m-21-01.prereq.0: Ukwandisa imveliso yeentetho ezimbini zekhwadrathi nokuhlela amalungu ezinga elifanayo (inqanaba leyunithi ye-polynomial kwiCommon Math, ibanga lesi-3 lesikolo samabanga aphakathi ukuya kwibanga eli-1 lesikolo samabanga aphezulu)
z-m-21-01.prereq.1: Intsingiselo ye-polynomial ezimbini ezintetho enye ku-x (i-identity). Ukubekwa kwebanga kwalo msebenzi kungumahlulo wobunzima ngaphakathi kwelo qela lemveliso kuphela hayi ukubelwa kwebanga kwikharityhulam
z-m-21-01.prereq.2: Amava okwandisa imveliso yeentetho ezilulayini ezifana ne-(x−1), (x+1)
z-m-21-01.s.s1.prompt: Ngowuphi umgca owenza isiphelo sika-Jiho "enye kuphela" sibe nzima ukuthembela njengoko sinjalo? Khetha umgca omnye.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula ukuba umgca ngamnye ulandela ngqo umgca osanda kudlula, nokuba kwelipi umgca gama elithi "le yeyodwa" livela kuqala.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca owenza uluhlu ngo "yenye ye~", njengomgca wesi-4, phinda wenze uluhlu ngokwakho phantsi kwemeko efanayo uze uthelekise enye enye noluhlu olubhalwe emgceni.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.0: Andisa (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) uze ufanise ikoyifishenti yezinga ngalinye ukuze ibe yintetho efanayo ne-x⁴−5x²+4.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukusuka kwikoyifishenti ye-x³, a+c=0, ngoko c=−a, kwaye ukusuka kwikoyifishenti ye-x, ad+bc=a(d−b)=0, ngoko a=0 okanye b=d.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.3: b no-d ziiinteger kwaye imveliso yazo yi-4, ngoko (b, d) yenye ye-(1, 4), (4, 1), (2, 2).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.4: Phakathi kwazo, enye kuphela eanelisa ikoyifishenti ye-x² b+d−a²=−5 yi-b=d=2, a=3 (okanye a=−3).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.explain: Ukubala kwimigca 1 ukuya kwi-3 kulungile (ikoyifishenti ye-x² yi-b+d+ac, kwaye ekubeni c=−a, yi-b+d−a²). Umgca wesi-4 yindawo apho kuphosakala kuqala. Izibini zee-integer ezineemveliso ye-4 ziquka nezi-(−1, −4), (−4, −1), (−2, −2), kodwa kubhalwe izibini eziqinisekileyo kuphela. Umgca wesi-5 ulungile "ngaphakathi koluhlu olubhalwe", kodwa uluhlu alugqibelelanga, ngoko "enye kuphela" kumgca wesi-6 ayinaxhaso. Nokuba ukhethe umgca wesi-6, ingxaki ayikokubala komgca ngokwawo kodwa "ukuba onke amatyala ajongwe ngaphambili".
z-m-21-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ukwahlula okuba-2 okwahlukeneyo (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) okulingana ne-x⁴−5x²+4. (a, b, c, d ziiinteger. Ezo zahluka kuphela ngolandelelwano zibalwa njengokwahlula okufanayo.)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.0: Phinda wenze uluhlu lwamaxabiso e-b, d kwisisombululo sika-Jiho ngokwakho, uze ubeke nezibini ezingekho kuluhlu kwimeko zekoyifishenti eziseleyo ukuze ujonge.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.1: Yahlula ube ngamasebe amabini, ityala a=0 netyala b=d, uze ufumane amaxabiso e-b no-d kwenye nenye.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.ok.c0: a, b, c, d zonke ziiinteger.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c0: Nceda uthathe a, b, c, d njenge-integer.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.explain: Zikho iindlela ezintathu ezinokwenzeka zokwahlula nge-integer: (x²−1)(x²−4), (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2), kunye ne-(x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Ukwahlula kuka-Jiho kunye nje kuzo. Ezo zahluka kuphela ngolandelelwano, njengokutshintshisa a no-−a, zabalwa njengokwahlula okufanayo.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Ukuba amaqela amabini ahlukeneyo omabini enza i-x⁴−5x²+4, isiphelo sika-Jiho "enye kuphela" siphosakele phi? Bhala izivakalisi ezimbini okanye ezintathu, usebenzisa ubuncinane enye yeentetho owazenzayo.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Andisa nganye yamaqela amabini owenzileyo uze uthelekise ukuba iziphumo zintetho enye na.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thelekisa indlela u-Jiho ahlele ngayo amatyala anokwenzeka nokuba amaqela owawenzileyo akuluhlu olo.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ujonge ngokwakho ukuba intetho oyinikileyo iba yi-x⁴−5x²+4 ngokwenene xa yandisiwe?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ukhomboile isizathu sempazamo njengo "kushiya amatyala anokwenzeka" kunokuba "yimpazamo yokubala"?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ubhale nento ekufuneka yenziwe ukuthi "enye kuphela"?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Ukwandisa (x²−1)(x²−4) kunika i-x⁴−5x²+4, kwaye ukwandisa (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2) kunika intetho efanayo nayo. Omabini amaqela alungile, ngoko ayiyiyo eyodwa. U-Jiho washiya izibini ezingalunganga phakathi kwezibini zee-integer ezineemveliso ye-4, ngoko kwashiyeka enye kuphela.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.0: Ikhankanya zombini umzekelo ochasayo (elinye iqela) nesizathu (ukushiya amatyala)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.1: I-x⁴−5x²+4 inokubhalwa njenge-(x−1)(x+1)(x−2)(x+2), ngoko ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni uzibeka njani iintetho ezine ezilulayini ngababini, ziphuma iimveliso ezininzi zeentetho zekhwadrathi, ezifana ne-(x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Isiphelo sika-Jiho sivela ekufumaneni indlela enye kuphela ngaphandle kokujonga onke amatyala.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ichazwe ngombono omnye, ukubeka iintetho ezilulayini ngamaqela
z-m-21-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku masandise imeko "iikoyifishenti ziiinteger" ibe "iikoyifishenti ngamanani okwenyani" (iintetho ezimbini zekhwadrathi ezineekoyifishenti ye-x² engu-1; ezo zahluka kuphela ngolandelelwano zinokwahlula okufanayo). Iimeko zekoyifishenti ezingasentla, a+c=0, a(d−b)=0, b+d−a²=−5, bd=4, zinokusetyenziswa njengoko zinjalo. Sesiphi isibhengezo esifanelekileyo kakhulu malunga nenani lokwahlula okunokwenzeka kule meko?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala kwi-a(d−b)=0, wahlule ube yityala a=0 netyala b=d, uze ubhale izilingano eziseleyo kwenye nenye.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kwisebe ngalinye, sombulula ngqo ubale ukuba b no-d zinokuthatha amaxabiso amangaphi xa ziyinani langempela.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.a: Kukho amanani angempela amaninzi kakhulu kunamanani apheleleyo, ngoko kukho ukuhlela okungapheliyo
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.a: Le ngcinga ibona ukuba xa amanani avumelekileyo andisa, iimpendulo nazo ziyanda. Kodwa kule meko, kuthekani ngokuqala ucinge ukuba iimeko zamakoyifishenti zibophelela njani a, b, c, d?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.b: Zisathathu. Kwiisebe ezimbini (xa a=0 nexa b=d), amaxabiso asele emiselwe
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.b: Esi sisigwebo esahlulwe sabe ziisebe ezimbini saza sahlola ukuba amaxabiso amiselwe na ngaphakathi kwamanani angempela nawo.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.c: Iyancipha xa kuthelekiswa namanani apheleleyo. Amanani angempela aquka amanani apheleleyo, ngoko imeko inzima ngakumbi
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.c: Uthathe isigqibo esichasayo kwinyaniso yokuba "amanani angempela aquka amanani apheleleyo." Xa uluhlu oluvumelekileyo luba banzi, ukuhlela okunokwenzeka akunakuncipha. Hlola ukuba ezintathu zemeko yamanani apheleleyo zisasebenza na.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.d: Esi sigwebo sithi "ulwazi alwanelanga" singabalanga ukuba ii-equation ezine ezinikiweyo ziyanela na. Hlola ukuba ii-unknown ezine ne-equation ezine ziyayincitshisa na amaxabiso.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.explain: Ukususela kuba a(d−b)=0, a=0 okanye b=d. Ukuba a=0, ngoko b+d=−5 kunye ne-bd=4, ngoko b no-d zii-roots ezimbini kuphela −1 kunye ne-−4 zika-t²+5t+4=0. Ukuba b=d, ngoko b²=4 inika b=±2, kwaye a²=2b+5, ngoko xa b=2, a=±3, kwaye xa b=−2, a=±1. Nakwiinani angempela akukho nto ingaphandle kwezi sebe, ngoko ungajongi ulandelelwano, zisathathu. Imeko yokuba linani eliphelele ayizange idlale indima yokuhluza kule meko.
